name: Bill Clinton

lean.basis: Democratic governor of Arkansas and 42nd president (1993–2001); ran as a centrist "New Democrat", and his "Third Way" philosophy became known as Clintonism.

current_role: Former President of the United States (1993–2001); founder of the Clinton Foundation
summary: Bill Clinton, a Democrat, was governor of Arkansas and the 42nd president of the United States (1993–2001), governing as a centrist "New Democrat". He founded the Clinton Foundation after leaving office and is married to Hillary Clinton. His past ties to Jeffrey Epstein led the House Oversight Committee to depose him in February 2026, where he said he knew nothing of Epstein's crimes.

sources.title: Bill and Hillary Clinton depositions in the Epstein files probe — NPR

connections.description: Emanuel was finance director of Clinton's 1992 campaign and a senior White House adviser (1993–1998).

connections.name: Jeffrey Epstein
connections.description: Clinton flew with Epstein on four trips abroad in 2002–2003 tied to Clinton Foundation work, his spokesman said in 2019; flight logs reportedly show more flights. In a February 2026 House deposition he said he knew nothing of Epstein's crimes and never visited his island.
